products.name: ATOM / Aliston K1 Series A121 / SF-400 Digital Kitchen Scale
products.summary: A simple 10 kg digital kitchen scale with 1 g readout, tare function and multiple weighing modes. Its low typical selling price makes it a practical basic kitchen tool rather than a premium precision scale.
products.why_picked: It solves a clear everyday problem at a low purchase price: portioning ingredients, measuring food and handling basic household weighing. The tracked price has repeatedly stayed in the low-₹200 range, so we prefer a Good Value verdict rather than claiming an exceptional or lowest-ever deal.
good_for: Basic food measurement up to 10 kg
watch_out: The 1 g figure is the display/readout increment; do not treat this as laboratory-grade accuracy.
Marketplace price, seller and availability can change.
Check the exact variant and listing details before ordering.

signals.price_history_note: Third-party tracker showed repeated prices around ₹204–₹249 during 2026, including ₹210 after a June 2026 drop. Treat tracker data as a research signal, not a marketplace guarantee.
